members.name: items
members.doc: The tree as data: strings, or items with an `id`, a `label`, a `textValue`, `disabled`, and nested `children` (or `items`). Give every item an id that is unique across the whole tree and stable when the data changes. An item without an id takes its key, value, or position among its siblings as its id, and a repeated id gets a numeric suffix in tree order. A disabled item disables all of its descendants.

members.name: selectedIds
members.doc: The selected item ids when the caller controls the selection, or `'all'`.

members.name: defaultSelectedIds
members.doc: The ids selected at first when the tree controls its own selection, or `'all'`.

members.name: expandedIds
members.doc: The expanded item ids when the caller controls expansion, or `'all'`.

members.name: defaultExpandedIds
members.doc: The ids expanded at first when the tree controls its own expansion, or `'all'`.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables every item and stops the selection, expansion, and action callbacks.

members.name: selectionMode
members.doc: How many items can be selected.

members.name: expansionTrigger
members.doc: What expands a parent item. With `row`, a click or tap on its label or row space expands or collapses it; with `chevron`, only its chevron control does.

members.name: onSelectionChange
members.doc: Called with the selected item ids, or `'all'`, when the selection changes. It is not called while the tree is disabled.

members.name: onExpandedChange
members.doc: Called with the expanded item ids, or `'all'`, when an item expands or collapses. It is not called while the tree is disabled.

members.name: onAction
members.doc: Called with the item record when the user activates an item. With selection on, a click or Enter runs it while nothing is selected and Space starts a selection; once an item is selected, a click changes the selection instead. It is not called for a disabled item or while the tree is disabled.
